strategies.text:
Overview

Fire blast is one of the hardest routes for Palkia for two reasons.

  1. The catch tanks are weaker with Baxcalibur having both a narrower catch tank window & less DPS.
  2. The rotation Eternatus must do to reach 4 dynamax cannons per phase can often place it near 1-5hp, just enough to faint to a dragon breath which is observed to increase phantom rejoin likelihood.

In the current meta this route may be the hardest Palkia route among all 4 dragon breath + charge movesets aside from Aqua tail if completed with Mega Rayquaza. The route is almost entirely determined by RNG. Make sure to complete fast rejoins.

Est Time to Win: 299-300s

Main Strategy

Eternatus: Must be 15 attack.

Aim for 4 Dynamax cannons per cycle. This can be achieved 5 ways.

  1. [Ideal] Palkia only does 1 fire blast
  2. [Rare/Ideal] Palkia dragon breaths all the way through giving you 5 dynamax cannons
  3. [Ok] Palkia does 2 fire blasts. 1 is caught, the other absorbed.
  4. [Slow, high risk] Palkia does 3+ fire blasts. 2 are caught, 1 is absorbed.
  5. [Slow-ok, high risk]Palkia does 4 fire blasts. 2 are caught by baxcalibur, 2 are absorbed but a 5th one is cast in transition allowing the 4th dynamax cannon to go through.

Make sure not to overtap Dragon tails as dragon breath can often top off energy.

[Support DPS Option 1] Mega Dragonite:

Aim for 2 Outrage+ This can be achieved 3-4 ways

  1. Ideal: Palkia does 3 fire blasts, 1 in transition, 2 b2b.
  2. Ok: Palkia does 2 fire blasts, fully absorbed
  3. Ok-slow: Palkia does 2 fire blasts, 1 CT'd
  4. Slow: Palkia does 1 fire blast or 0 fire blasts. (Make up DPS later or bail)

Make sure not to overtap Dragon tails as dragon breath can often top off energy.

[Support DPS Option 2] Mega Rayquaza:

Aim for 7-8 breaking swipes gained from tanking consecutive fire blasts. Weave breaking swipes inside fire blast cast animation to maximize chance.

  1. Ideal: Palkia does 3 fire blasts, grants you 7-8 breaking swipes immediately.
  2. Ideal-Ok: Palkia does 2 fire blasts quickly, grants you 5-6 breaking swipes.
  3. Ok: Palkia does 2 slow fire blasts, grants you 6-7 breaking swipes over a long time
  4. Slow: Palkia does 1 Fire blast, grants 5-6 breakings swipes over long time
  5. Bail: Palkia does not fire blast.


Baxcalibur:

Catch tank poorly timed fire blasts; optionally trail or drive by.

  1. Catch tank poorly timed fire blasts; those that would overflow in energy.
  2. Trailing CT is okay if fire blast timing is 1t offset from last charge move hit.
  3. Drive by CT is okay if fire blast timing is 1t offset during switch from Main to Support DPS.
  4. Drive by CT is a catch tank interaction when swapping from Main to Support DPS. Happens by chance.

Shadow Haxorus/Garchomp:

Execute the boss last cycle if not using Mega Rayquaza or if support DPS is too low.

strategies.text:
Overview

Draco Meteor Palkia is the first raid to use Mega Dragonite as a catch tank, alongside 4 Shadow Dialga. Even if the strategy seems like a classic catch tank strategy at first view, it asks for a good knowledge of your own fast moves duration, Palkia’s Draco Meteor duration and a good timing of switching for your catch tanks. If you don’t have a Best Buddy Mega Dragonite, it also asks to dodge a Dragon Breath without dodging the Draco Meteor, we will see this below.

Est Time to Win

297 - 300s

Main Strategy

Eternatus

The main DPS. 15 attack is required (there is a Dragon Tail breakpoint). Your goal is to throw 5 Dynamax Cannon per lobby.


Mega Dragonite (priority Catch Tank)

This is the newcomer to soloing raids. It has been discovered that Best Buddy hundo Dragonite hits a bulkpoint on Dragon Breath and an HP check to survive a Draco Meteor AND 2 (two) Dragon breath, making it a great catch tank. Dragonite’s moveset is also slightly different : you need to use Dragon Breath instead of Dragon Tail. Draco Meteor energy when catch tanking and 1 Dragon Tail is not enough to make it to Outrage++++, forcing a second Dragon Tail. You need 3 Dragon Breath and catch tank Draco Meteor to get Outrage++++, which saves 0.5sec (in 4 lobbies, it saves a total of 2 seconds). In every lobby, you have to catch tank on Dragonite (unless Palkia doesn’t want to throw a Draco Meteor during a whole lobby).


Shadow Dialga

This is the only Pokémon (besides Mega Dragonite) who can survive a Draco Meteor and hits back hard enough to still be worth catch tanking. Their main purpose is to prevent relobbying way too often, it is ok if you don’t catch tank on all your Dialga in every lobby. They also can be a bit underleveled/low IVs, but they have to survive 1 Draco Meteor and 2 Dragon Breath to be able to throw back a Draco Meteor.


Some tricks you have to know

• Relobby sniping is a thing, and sadly Eternatus does not survive a Draco Meteor (actually he does but 1 Dragon Breath KOs), but the raid has near to no error margin, so you have to make a choice :

  1. Either you lead Eternatus for every lobby and you hope to don’t get sniped
  2. Or you lead a Shadow Dialga (except for the first lobby !!) and you hope to actually get sniped


• Draco Meteor has a duration of 3.5 seconds, how’s that important ? Not only it will help you maximize your Eternatus energy, but also use Mega Dragonite as a catch tank perfectly. Whenever you see “Palkia uses Draco Meteor”, you have time to do 2 Dragon Tail (2*1 second), switch to your Dragonite, throw 3 Dragon Breath and get your Outrage++++ ready, have time to throw it and go back to Eternatus. Be careful of one thing : if you throw a Dynamax Cannon during Palkia’s Draco Meteor, Palkia might throw Draco Meteor back to back and make catch tanking on Dragonite useless. If you want to be safe in this scenario, use a Dialga as catch tank so you can use Dragonite at a better moment.


• Even if your main DPS uses a 1 second fast move, TPC is required for a perfect use of Dragonite and Dialga, since they both use Dragon Breath. Not knowing how to TPC will make you lose half a second on every single catch tank, and this raid is too hard to allow that. If you don’t know what TPC is, check Tick Perfect Cast


• You don’t have a Best Buddy hundo Mega Dragonite ? 2 people managed to find a way to solo DM Palkia without a Best Buddy. After catch tanking a Draco Meteor, you have to dodge 1 Dragon Breath then throw your Outrage++++. Dodging that single Dragon Breath let’s enough HP to Dragonite to survive the next Dragon Breath. While soloing Palkia without Best Buddy Dragonite is possible, it is also harder since you lose time by dodging with Dragonite at every lobby.
